sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: The Chimes Child is a British folkloric figure. In rural Somerset, a child born in a specific window held unusual gifts. The birth came after midnight on Friday. It had to end before dawn on Saturday. People believed such a child had the Second Sight. They also believed the child would become a healer.

okr.objective: The Chimes Child is a gifted child born at a set time in Somerset.
